data.content_ref: inline:The simulation of independence via 'statelessness' (SRC_002) integrates with the concept of 'Cognitive Covariance' (SRC_003) by attempting to remove the 'authoring trace' while remaining susceptible to the 'training prior'. This relation is refuted if a context wipe successfully eliminates the 'fingerprints' of the authoring phase but the checker still accepts the same systemic hallucinations due to shared weights.
